name: List Landing Page Domains
summary: Lists the landing page domains known to this Marketo instance (custom domains, aliases).
whenToUse: When you need to know which domains your landing pages can be served from.

query.name: maxReturn
query.label: Max to return
query.hint: How many domains to return (with offset to page).

response.description: Domain records: hostname and type (e.g. domain-alias).

notes: Permission per the endpoint reference is 'Read-Only Redirect Rules'.
